source.stem:
The diagram shows the speed-time graph for a car.
Which area represents the distance travelled while the car is accelerating?
A X B X + Y C Y D Y – X

mx.teacher_note: The length around the bottle's base cannot be measured with thread.

intelligence.enrichment: A curved line can be measured with a flexible measuring tape or by laying a thread along the curve, straightening the thread, and measuring the straightened thread with a metre scale. curve traced by flexible tape or thread -> straight measurable length of the same curve The learner correctly applies this rule: A curved line can be measured with a flexible measuring tape or by laying a thread along the curve, straightening the thread, and measuring the straightened thread with a metre scale. A curved line is measured by the straight gap between its two ends.
